title: Pan-Seared Fish with Croatian Flaky Pastry
description: A simple and flavorful fish dish paired with a traditional Croatian pastry.

ingredients.name: Herbal butter
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh herbs like parsley or dill work great.

instructions: Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the fish to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Transfer the fish to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, roll out the Croatian flaky pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry on top of the fish and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the fish from the oven and brush with herbal butter.
Serve with lemon wedges on the side (if desired).
Enjoy your delicious Pan-Seared Fish with Croatian Flaky Pastry!
